control.metric: system-wide CPU utilisation minus this benchmark process's own share
control.rationale: This benchmark runs on a shared developer workstation. A repeat measured while an unrelated workload occupies the CPU characterises the host rather than the candidate, so external load is sampled before and throughout every repeat and a contaminated repeat can never satisfy the calibration margin.
control.rejected_attempt_handling: A measurement whose host-load control failed is a rejected attempt, not a repeat. It is preserved as evidence and the repeat is measured again, up to the attempt bound, so a host artefact can never exclude a candidate the way the superseded eligibility rule excluded one. Only the host-load control may trigger a re-measurement; a repeat that failed on any candidate metric stands as recorded.
